description: Powerful, low-latency speech generation with natural outputs, steerable prompts, and expressive audio tags for precise narration control.

i18n.en: Powerful, low-latency speech generation with natural outputs, steerable prompts, and expressive audio tags for precise narration control.
i18n.zh: 强大的低延迟语音生成模型，支持自然输出、可控提示词和表达力音频标签，实现精确的叙述控制。

description: Fast and controllable text-to-speech for low-latency, cost-efficient applications and real-time assistants. Supports single and multi-speaker output.

i18n.en: Fast and controllable text-to-speech for low-latency, cost-efficient applications and real-time assistants. Supports single and multi-speaker output.
i18n.zh: 快速可控的文本转语音模型，适用于低延迟、低成本应用和实时助手。支持单说话人和多说话人输出。

description: High-fidelity speech synthesis optimized for quality in structured workflows like podcasts and audiobooks. Offers fine control over style and pacing.

i18n.en: High-fidelity speech synthesis optimized for quality in structured workflows like podcasts and audiobooks. Offers fine control over style and pacing.
i18n.zh: 高保真语音合成模型，针对播客和有声书等结构化工作流优化。提供对风格和节奏的精细控制。
